dialog.agent:
**Nothing has been generated, and no credits have been spent.**

The connected tools don’t offer standalone text-to-speech with audio-only output. They do offer narration within a video-production workflow, at **24 credits per second of narration**—about **240 credits for 10 seconds**, before any video costs. That isn’t an appropriate workaround for your audio-only request, and I won’t start it.

Cheaper options:
- **Use your device’s built-in text-to-speech or record it yourself:** no Magic Hour credits. Audio-file export depends on the app.
- **Shorter:** your script is 18 words. Around 8–10 seconds is reasonable; shortening it much further would compromise the calm pace. I wouldn’t change your exact wording.
- **Smaller:** a mono MP3 would reduce file size, but wouldn’t reduce the documented per-second narration charge.

For this request, a free text-to-speech app with audio export is the best fit. Paste exactly:

> Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.

Choose a calm voice with brief pauses between sentences, and disable background audio.
